_note: Descriptions say what each repo honestly is. Edit freely, then run scripts/apply-repo-metadata.mjs.

repos.name: cascade-payments
repos.description: A payments backend built around the failure cases: a provider timeout is not a decline. C#, .NET, PostgreSQL, Stripe and Shopify. Runs on simulated data.

repos.name: vehicle-watch
repos.description: Fleet fault detection with no labelled data. Isolation Forest and Local Outlier Factor score every sensor reading, Gemini explains each anomaly. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis. Demo data.

repos.name: VeriLoom
repos.description: Hiring by real work. An LLM grades submitted deliverables, then an AI interview keyed to the candidate's own submission tests understanding. Built, not yet deployed.

repos.name: influence
repos.description: InfluencePay: escrow-backed influencer deals. A Solidity escrow contract, an Express API and a Next.js frontend. Client project, delivered. Runs on the Sepolia test network.
